anatomyReview.notes: Whole right-facing pale gray beige dove only, black half collar at side/back of neck, dark red iris/pale eye ring, slender dark bill, pale terminal tail and pink legs. One head/bill, two folded wings far side occluded, two feet. Original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; independent expert and native review pending.

Cooing dove on flowering low twig, one head/open bill, two folded wings far side occluded and two gripping feet. Crown/tail/bill entirely inside frame, twig ends/fades below crown without upper crop.
